stem: What is one way that the bats in “Night Flyers” and the honeybees in “A Sweet Part of Nature” are different?

options.label: A
options.text: Bats eat insects, while bees do not.

options.label: B
options.text: Bats spread pollen, while bees do not.

options.label: C
options.text: Bats catch diseases, while bees do not.

options.label: D
options.text: Bats need new houses, while bees do not.
